images.prebuild:
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/baguskto/kbbi-api.git "$tmp/dataset"
git -C "$tmp/dataset" checkout 13fd4ea6f50baec4b756fb473d402f55307e0e71
git -C "$tmp/dataset" sparse-checkout set kbbi-dataset-kbbi-v-main/json
mkdir -p kbbi-dataset-kbbi-v-main
mv "$tmp/dataset/kbbi-dataset-kbbi-v-main/json" kbbi-dataset-kbbi-v-main/
rm -rf "$tmp"
ls kbbi-dataset-kbbi-v-main/json
